David — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks.

Short answer on notice window: Redwood's standard notification is 30 days for non-critical subprocessors. That said, we understand Zephyr's risk profile and can negotiate a different cadence for classified vendors. To move forward quickly I propose the following compromise: 45-day calendar notice for new subprocessors, with a documented objection process and short operational review window (we can put 15 business days on the table).

Operational asks from our side: if you need SOC2 / audit evidence, we can share our SOC2 report via a secure link (see later email). Also — we typically execute DPAs via DocuSign; if Zephyr prefers AdobeSign we can accommodate but DocuSign is faster for our legal ops.

I've looped in Monica and Karthik (ops/legal) to confirm the 45/15 approach and to prepare a redline that reflects the objection steps and evidence exchange. Can you confirm whether Zephyr can accept 45 days as a compromise?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Initial DPA redline and notice window question

David / team —

Thanks for the redline. Attached is Redwood's proposed DPA redline that includes the compromise language (Redwood_DPA_v3_redline.pdf) and an annex with our current third-party list (Redwood_Annex_C_List_v1.csv). Key legal points we adjusted: 

- Notification window: 45 calendar days for new subprocessors (Section 3.2).
- Objection process: Customer must object in writing within the 45-day window. Upon receipt of a written objection, Redwood will (a) provide remediation details and any compensating controls, and (b) engage to identify an alternative or remediation within 15 business days.
- If the parties cannot agree on mitigating steps within an additional 15 business days, Zephyr will have the limited right to suspend processing of the affected data types as a last resort; termination rights are preserved only where materially required under the DPA (we tried to keep this balanced).
- Evidence: SOC2 report and relevant audit summaries will be shared via secure link; we can provide a redacted version for procurement review.

We recommend executing the attached redline via DocuSign (we will prepare the envelope and send). Let us know if Zephyr counsel would like a tracked-change PDF before routing.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference

Rishi / Neha — appreciate the fast turnaround and the annex. A couple of practical notes from Zephyr Legal / Procurement: 

- 60 days is our preferred window because clinical procurement requires vendor questionnaires and a formal security review; 45 days would be acceptable only if Redwood commits to providing a dedicated remediation plan within 10 business days rather than 15, and if there is a guaranteed escalation path to a named security contact.
- We also need confirmation on retention of audit logs for 13 months (for compliance audits) and a clear SLA for how quickly a noncompliant subprocessor can be removed.

If Redwood can agree to 45 days + 10-business-day remediation response + 13-month audit log retention, Zephyr is prepared to move forward with eSign this week. Otherwise we'll need to stick with 60 days.

-David
David Turner
Director, Procurement | Zephyr Health

David — quick follow from ops/security: we can accept 45 calendar days for notification. We can also firm the remediation timeline to 15 business days but are willing to make a one-time concession to 10 business days for Zephyr on this contract given the clinical nature of your work, provided the scope of required remediation is clearly documented in the objection notice.

On the other asks:
- Audit logs: we can retain and make available relevant audit logs for 13 months; access will be via our secure portal / audited request process.
- Subprocessor removal SLA: if a subprocessor is found noncompliant and remediation is not accepted, Redwood will remove the subprocessor for the affected workload within 30 calendar days of the final remediation determination (we'll document the operational steps in an annex).

We will generate the DocuSign envelope this morning and include the agreed compromise language: 45-day notice, objection in writing, remediation plan within 10 business days for this agreement, and 13-month audit log retention. Link to the envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/abcd1234zephyr

Regards,
